mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMUNITY ( COMMU_NUM, BOARD_NUM, EMPLOYEE_NUM, MEMBER_NUM, COMPANY_NUM, COMMU_SUBJECT, COMMU_REGIST, COMMU_UPDATE, COMMU_CONTENTS, COMMU_IMAGE, COMMU_VIEWS, COMMU_STORE_NAME, COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME ) VALUES ( (SELECT NVL(MAX(COMMU_NUM), 0) + 1 FROM COMMUNITY), #{boardNum}, #{employeeNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{memberNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{companyNum, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commuSubject}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, #{commuContents}, #{commuImageStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 0, #{commuStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commuOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{commuImageOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.update: UPDATE COMMUNITY SET COMMU_SUBJECT = #{commuSubject}, COMMU_CONTENTS = #{commuContents}, COMMU_UPDATE = SYSDATE, COMMU_IMAGE = #{commuImageStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME = #{commuImageOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMMU_STORE_NAME = #{commuStoreName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME = #{commuOriginalName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE COMMU_NUM = #{commuNum}
mapper.select: SELECT c.COMMU_NUM, c.BOARD_NUM, c.EMPLOYEE_NUM, c.MEMBER_NUM, c.COMPANY_NUM, c.COMMU_SUBJECT, c.COMMU_REGIST, c.COMMU_UPDATE, c.COMMU_CONTENTS, c.COMMU_IMAGE, c.COMMU_VIEWS, c.COMMU_STORE_NAME, c.COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, c.COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME, NVL(m.MEMBER_NAME, e.EMPLOYEE_NAME) AS writer_name FROM COMMUNITY c LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON c.MEMBER_NUM = m.MEMBER_NUM LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON c.EMPLOYEE_NUM = e.EMPLOYEE_NUM WHERE c.BOARD_NUM = #{boardNum} ORDER BY c.COMMU_REGIST DESC

SELECT c.COMMU_NUM, c.BOARD_NUM, c.EMPLOYEE_NUM, c.MEMBER_NUM, c.COMPANY_NUM, c.COMMU_SUBJECT, c.COMMU_REGIST, c.COMMU_UPDATE, c.COMMU_CONTENTS, c.COMMU_IMAGE, c.COMMU_VIEWS, c.COMMU_STORE_NAME, c.COMMU_ORIGINAL_NAME, c.COMMU_IMAGE_ORIGINAL_NAME, NVL(m.MEMBER_NAME, e.EMPLOYEE_NAME) AS writer_name FROM COMMUNITY c LEFT JOIN MEMBER m ON c.MEMBER_NUM = m.MEMBER_NUM LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE e ON c.EMPLOYEE_NUM = e.EMPLOYEE_NUM WHERE c.COMPANY_NUM = #{companyNum} ORDER BY c.COMMU_REGIST DESC
